subject: AP channel proposal: XML sample vs manual PDF push
messages:
From: BlueArc AP <ap@bluearc.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Billing routing question + sample file for Redwood invoices

Hi Irene,

Quick question from our AP team as we get ready to go live: which channel will Redwood use to send invoices? Our AP system can ingest a nightly XML payload (preferred) or we can accept individual PDF invoices via email (fallback). Can you confirm what you typically provision for new customers and, if possible, send a sample XML schema and a sample PDF?

Also - our tax team flagged reverse-charge handling on EU invoices; we may need the VAT field populated on the invoice header even for US-originated billing. Can you advise?

Thanks,
Marta Delgado
AP Lead, BlueArc Systems
ap@bluearc.com

--
BlueArc Systems
AP Team: ap@bluearc.com

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: BlueArc AP <ap@bluearc.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Billing routing question + sample file for Redwood invoices

Hi Marta —

Thanks for the clear summary. Short answers up front:

- We support both options. Our preferred path for automation is a nightly XML push (SFTP or secure API) to your collector endpoint.
- We will also send PDF invoices to the billing contact by email as a fallback and for business users that require human-friendly copies.

Attached are: sample_invoice.xml (minimal required fields), sample_invoice.pdf (what the emailed PDF looks like), and a short onboarding checklist (redwood_onboarding_checklist.pdf) that outlines steps and expected fields.

A few implementation notes:
- XML: we include invoice_number, issue_date, net_amount, tax_amount, tax_rate, currency, and a VAT_id field for cases where VAT applies. If you tell us the field name your ERP expects for PO/Cost Center, we can include it.
- PDFs: delivered to the primary AP email once per invoice; we can configure a daily digest if you prefer fewer messages.
- Fallback logic: if the XML push fails for a run, we will send the PDF copy and mark the run as retried in our portal.

Connor is cc'd to handle the technical handoff and SFTP/API details. Kimberly — looping you in on the billing contact and SLA notes for the onboarding.

Next steps I propose:
1) Marta confirms whether you prefer SFTP ingestion or our push API and shares the preferred endpoint/credentials method.
2) Send your ERP's PO field name (if any) and whether you need invoice_line-level tax breakdowns.
3) We’ll schedule a short 30-min handoff with Connor to test the XML payload and confirm the digest cadence.

If you want, we can also enable a portal invite so your team can download invoices and set email preferences from a UI — that can reduce back-and-forth for future changes.

Best,
Irene Choi
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0164

Attachments: sample_invoice.xml (XML), sample_invoice.pdf (PDF), redwood_onboarding_checklist.pdf

From: Marta Delgado <marta.delgado@bluearc.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 13:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Billing routing question + sample file for Redwood invoices

Thanks, Irene — this is helpful. BlueArc's preference is to consume via SFTP nightly (our security team doesn't allow inbound API pushes for invoices). We'll provide an SFTP account for ingestion.

Couple of clarifications: 
- PO field name: we use "buyer_po_number" at the header level; including line-level PO is not required.
- VAT: for any EU shipments where reverse-charge applies we'll need VAT_id in the header and an explicit note that the tax_amount is 0 with tax_reason="reverse_charge". Can you include a tax_reason field in the XML?

One last thing — our AR team would like the invoice PDF copy sent to invoices@bluearc.com as well (copy to AP is fine). If you can confirm both the SFTP cadence and the fallback email address, we can move to credential exchange.

Best,
Marta

Hi Marta —

Perfect, SFTP nightly ingestion works on our side. Confirming the implementation details per your notes:

- SFTP cadence: nightly at 02:00 UTC (we'll include a run identifier in the file name).
- Header fields: we will populate "buyer_po_number" at the invoice header level.
- VAT / reverse-charge: we will add a tax_reason element (allowed values: "standard", "reverse_charge", "exempt"). When tax_reason="reverse_charge" tax_amount will be 0 and VAT_id will be present.
- PDF copy: we'll deliver the human-readable PDF to invoices@bluearc.com and ap@bluearc.com.

Next steps:
1) Connor will generate a one-time test file and coordinate SFTP credentials exchange. Connor — can you schedule a 30-minute test window next week?
2) Marta — once SFTP credentials are available, please share them in a secure channel (we prefer an SFTP key or an encrypted secrets upload).

Ilya from our security team also flagged a simple integrity check we can include (SHA256 checksum file alongside payload) — we'll add that by default unless you prefer otherwise.

Thanks, and we'll get the test file over by Monday EOD.

Regards,
Irene Choi
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
